issue.title: bob panics (exit 101) on EPIPE when a reader closes its stdout pipe early, e.g. bob stats -f json | head
issue.description:
`bob` never restores default SIGPIPE handling and has no `BrokenPipe` handling anywhere in `src/` (grep for `SIGPIPE|BrokenPipe` is empty). Rust's runtime ignores SIGPIPE, so when a reader closes the pipe early, the next `print!`/`println!` returns EPIPE and std panics.

Root cause (confident): `src/native/stats/cli.rs:171-173` writes the report with `print!`/`println!`. Any `bob` subcommand whose stdout exceeds the pipe buffer (~64 KB) is affected. `bob stats -f json` (80–335 KB) reproduces it reliably. `bob plan -f json` (3 KB) does not, because its write completes before `head` exits.

Fix options: restore `SIGPIPE` to `SIG_DFL` at the start of `main` on unix, or route stdout writes through a helper that treats `ErrorKind::BrokenPipe` as a clean exit 0. Either way, add a regression test that pipes `bob stats -f json` into a reader that closes after 1 byte and asserts no panic text on stderr.

Found by research agent cld while measuring `bob stats` for the daily-note Day stats strip research (`research:202610/daily_note_day_stats_strip__cld.md`, §10).

task_type_fields.impact: Cosmetic but noisy: shell pipelines into head/jq-on-error/python print a panic and exit 101; the Obsidian plugin is unaffected because execFile reads all output.
task_type_fields.location: src/native/stats/cli.rs:171-173 (print!/println! of the report); no SIGPIPE/BrokenPipe handling in src/
task_type_fields.repro: bob stats -f json -r 7d | head -c 10  # stderr: thread 'main' panicked ... failed printing to stdout: Broken pipe (os error 32); exit 101

issue.creation_reason: Found while timing bob stats for the Day stats strip research; a CLI should exit quietly when its reader closes the pipe, not print a Rust panic.

payload.description: Also a broken-pipe panic, but in a test helper writing a child's stdin; different root cause, adjacent symptom
Scope batch-9 successor phases for bo, 8q, and bl
Need defect details for epipe phase

payload.entry: Baseline 6292c35b introduced two defects: silent hook for all panics (empty non-EPIPE branch + resume_unwind never runs hook, so unrelated panics exit 101 with no message; thread panics also silenced) and usage-error BrokenPipe mapped to 0 in route_help and run_bob_with_args. Fix: factored run_with_quiet_epipe in src/runner.rs that delegates non-EPIPE to previous hook at panic time and maps only EPIPE print panics to 0; changed both BrokenPipe branches to return clap exit_code (help/version stay 0, usage stays 2); applied same BrokenPipe-quiet-but-keep-exit-code guard to all native print_clap_error paths (notably stats/cli.rs, required for stats --bogus-flag). Tests: 10 lib runner tests green (3 new re-exec guard probes), 3 epipe CLI tests green (1 existing + 2 new closed-pipe usage/help), just check green. Hand checks on rebuilt CARGO_TARGET_DIR bob: stats -f json | head -c 10 pipefail 0 empty stderr; --help | head -c 1 0 empty stderr; (sleep 0.3; bob bogus-subcommand 2>&1)|true 2; (sleep 0.3; bob stats --bogus-flag 2>&1)|true 2.
